3.name: Improved Critical (Champion)
3.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

7.name: Remarkable Athlete (Champion)
7.description: Add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded up) to any STR, DEX, or CON check that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus, and boost running long jump by STR modifier feet.

10.name: Additional Fighting Style (Champion)
10.description: You choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

15.name: Superior Critical (Champion)
15.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

18.name: Survivor (Champion)
18.description: At the start of each of your turns, regain HP equal to 5 + CON modifier if you have no more than half your HP remaining (above 0).

improved_critical.name: Improved Critical
improved_critical.hint: Widened crit range — the Attack button already flags these as crits.

3.name: Combat Superiority & Student of War
3.description: Learn 3 Battle Master Maneuvers fueled by 4 d8 Superiority Dice (Short/Long Rest) and gain proficiency in one artisan's tool.

7.name: Know Your Enemy
7.description: Study a creature outside combat for 1 minute to compare relative stats, HP, AC, or Fighter levels.

10.name: Improved Combat Superiority
10.description: Your Superiority Dice turn into d10s (plus learn 2 additional maneuvers at L7/L10).

15.name: Relentless
15.description: When you roll Initiative and have no Superiority Dice remaining, you regain 1 Superiority Die.

18.name: Improved Combat Superiority (d12)
18.description: Your Superiority Dice turn into d12s.

superiority_dice.name: Superiority Die
superiority_dice.hint: Spend one on a maneuver. Pool of 4, rising to 5 at 7th and 6 at 15th.

3.name: Spellcasting & Weapon Bond
3.description: Cast Wizard spells (INT; Abjuration and Evocation focus) and bond up to two weapons so you cannot be disarmed and can summon them as a Bonus Action.

7.name: War Magic
7.description: When you use your Action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

10.name: Eldritch Strike
10.description: Creatures hit by your weapon attack have Disadvantage on their next saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

15.name: Arcane Charge
15.description: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see when you use Action Surge.

18.name: Improved War Magic
18.description: When you use your Action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

3.name: Arcane Archer Lore & Arcane Shot
3.description: Gain Arcana or Nature proficiency and Prestidigitation/Druidcraft, plus 2 magical Arcane Shot options (2/Short or Long Rest on shortbow/longbow hits).

7.name: Magic Arrow & Curving Shot
7.description: Shortbow/longbow arrows count as magical; use a Bonus Action to redirect a missed magic arrow toward another target within 60 ft.

10.name: Additional Arcane Shot
10.description: Learn an additional Arcane Shot option (more choices also gained at L7/L15/L18).

15.name: Ever-Ready Shot
15.description: If you roll Initiative with 0 Arcane Shot uses remaining, regain one use.

18.name: Master Arcane Shots
18.description: All Arcane Shot damage dice scale up (e.g. 4d6 / improved secondary dice).

3.name: Bonus Proficiency, Born to the Saddle & Unwavering Mark
3.description: Adv vs falling off mount, 5 ft mount/dismount, and Unwavering Mark imposing Disadvantage + bonus revenge strike (STR mod/Long Rest).

7.name: Warding Maneuver
7.description: Reaction grants +1d8 AC and Resistance to an adjacent ally or yourself on hit (CON mod/Long Rest).

10.name: Hold the Line
10.description: Creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks when moving 5 ft or more within your reach, dropping their speed to 0 on hit.

15.name: Ferocious Charger
15.description: Move 10+ ft straight before hitting to force a STR save or knock the target Prone.

18.name: Vigilant Defender
18.description: Take a special Reaction once on every other creature's turn solely for Opportunity Attacks.

3.name: Bonus Proficiency & Fighting Spirit
3.description: Gain one social/History skill; Bonus Action grants Advantage on all weapon attacks this turn plus Temporary HP (3/Long Rest).

7.name: Elegant Courtier
7.description: Add WIS modifier to Persuasion checks and gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (or INT/CHA if already proficient).

10.name: Tireless Spirit
10.description: Regain 1 use of Fighting Spirit whenever you roll Initiative with 0 uses remaining.

15.name: Rapid Strike
15.description: Forgo Advantage on one Attack action strike to make one additional weapon attack as part of the same action.

18.name: Strength Before Death
18.description: Reaction upon dropping to 0 HP to immediately take an extra turn before falling unconscious (1/Long Rest).

3.name: Psionic Power
3.description: Gain Psionic Energy Dice equal to 2 x PB (d6, scales to d8/d10/d12) for Protective Field, Psionic Strike, and Telekinetic Movement.

7.name: Telekinetic Adept
7.description: Gain Psi-Powered Leap (Fly speed = 2x Speed until turn end) and Telekinetic Thrust (push 10 ft or knock Prone on Psionic Strike).

10.name: Guarded Mind
10.description: Gain Resistance to Psychic damage and spend a Psionic Die at the start of your turn to end Charmed and Frightened conditions.

15.name: Bulwark of Force
15.description: Bonus Action grants Half Cover (+2 AC & DEX saves) to up to INT mod allies within 30 ft for 1 minute.

18.name: Telekinetic Master
18.description: Cast Telekinesis without components (1/Long Rest or 1 Psionic Die) and make one Bonus Action weapon attack each turn while concentrating.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies, Rune Carver & Giant's Might
3.description: Gain smith's tools & Giant language; inscribe 2 magical Runes on gear; Bonus Action becomes Large (+1d6 damage, STR Adv, PB/Long Rest).

7.name: Runic Shield
7.description: Reaction forces an attacker to reroll an attack hitting an ally within 60 ft (PB/Long Rest).

10.name: Great Stature
10.description: Giant's Might extra damage rises to 1d8 (learn 4th Rune).

15.name: Master of Runes
15.description: Invoke each known Rune twice per Short or Long Rest (learn 5th Rune).

18.name: Runic Juggernaut
18.description: Giant's Might grows up to Huge size, adds +5 ft reach, and deals 1d10 extra damage.

3.name: Manifest Echo & Unleash Incarnation
3.description: Bonus Action conjures a translucent Echo you can swap places with and attack through; make CON mod extra attacks per Long Rest from your Echo.

7.name: Echo Avatar
7.description: Transfer your senses into your Echo up to 1,000 ft away for 10 minutes.

10.name: Shadow Martyr
10.description: Reaction teleports your Echo in front of an attacked ally to intercept the attack (1/Short or Long Rest).

15.name: Reclaim Potential
15.description: When an Echo is destroyed, gain 2d6 + CON mod Temporary HP (CON mod/Long Rest).

18.name: Legion of One
18.description: Manifest two Echoes simultaneously and regain 1 Unleash Incarnation use when rolling Initiative with 0 left.
